system.description:
Battle Amp

Your Will Surges.

Kindling. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Will.

Apotheosis. Reduce the Will cost for Unified Form by 1.

Blazing Limits. You gain a +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons.
system.summary: Regain 1 Will each turn, Unified Form costs 1 less Will, and +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons.

rules.text: Start: Will of Fire Incarnate, a Bonus action; your Will blazes for 1 minute, once per long rest.
Blazing Limits: +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons (at the table).
